changes: No substantive changes; note expanded to flag the catalogue/colophon date conflict (LS 433 vs LS 528) and that the scribe and place appear only in the catalogue fields

notes: The quoted colophon (fol. 58v, end of the 5th pariccheda) names only the author Govinda and gives the date LS 528 Kārttika śukla 2 (≈1647 CE). The catalogue fields give the scribe as Vaṃśamaṇi, the date as LS 433 vaiśākhaśuklacaturthī bhaumavāsara (≈1552 CE) and the place as Śataṃlakhāgrāma. None of these appear in this excerpt. They probably come from another colophon in the manuscript, perhaps a final or second one that wasn't quoted. Because the dates differ by 95 years, the manuscript may be composite, or one of the two dates may be a misreading. The scribe and place aren't recorded here because the quoted colophon doesn't support them. Check against the manuscript images.
